changes.reason: The fluent validator contract and EF model configuration agree on 200 and required title. Wording should distinguish model metadata from database enforcement, especially for the specified SQLite variant; IsRequired also is not equivalent to NotEmpty string validation.

before.requirement: Create validator enforces nonempty title and maximum200; entity configuration also requires title with maximum200, so changes must coordinate.

evidence.excerpt:
RuleFor(v => v.Title)
            .NotEmpty()
            .MaximumLength(200)
            .MustAsync(BeUniqueTitle)
                .WithMessage("'{PropertyName}' must be unique.")
                .WithErrorCode("Unique");

after.requirement: Create validation configures NotEmpty and MaximumLength(200). TodoListConfiguration configures Title with HasMaxLength(200) and IsRequired, so title-rule changes must coordinate validator and EF model metadata. This does not establish database enforcement of length, and IsRequired is not the same as rejecting every empty/whitespace string.
